snippet.title: MindsEye – BLACKLISTED | Powered by ARCADIA
snippet.description:
Step into the role of Julia Black, a world-class assassin deployed by Meridian to Redrock City. In BLACKLISTED, your mission is simple: eliminate two key targets and shut down a deadly deal. But Meridian is under attack from the outside and undermined from within, so every move carries risk. Infiltrate the criminal network, sabotage the operation, and expose the truth. 
 
Update your game and play BLACKLISTED now, the new ARCADIA mission available in MindsEye.  

Available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam, Epic Game Store). For more information, visit MindsEye.Game or follow @MindsEyeGame on social media.  

Steam: https://go.mindseye.game/steam  
PlayStation: https://go.mindseye.game/playstation  
Xbox: https://go.mindseye.game/xbox
